beats.summary: Michael introduces his new girlfriend at the party but is confused about which waitress she is.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Hello? I would like everybody to meet my new girlfriend.
Michael: It's… it's one of those two.

beats.summary: Angela confronts a waitress for taking a toy from the table, asserting boundaries.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Hey, excuse me! Waitress lady! Hey, where do you think you're going with that?
Angela: You can't have it I don't walk into your house and steal your Hello Kitty backpack.

beats.summary: Dwight wins a raffle prize of walkie-talkies and shares a moment holding Angela's hand.
Karen announces the disbanding of the Committee to Plan Parties and suggests merging two parties.

evidence.snippet: Karen: Well the Committee to Plan Parties has served its purpose. We're gonna disband. In the name of Christmas.
Karen: Angela, we've been hearing really great thing about uh… your brownies and we were hoping you'd consider merging into two parties.

beats.summary: Michael marks the waitress's arm with a black marker to tell the two waitresses apart.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I, I put a mark on her arm. So I could tell them apart.

beats.summary: Michael realizes he had a rebound relationship with the waitress and feels conflicted about it.
